contract.application_relevance: Workers assemble uploads with user files, renamed attachments, and generated Blobs.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Unrenamed File is identical; renamed File is distinct upload.txt with unchanged bytes/type/123456789 lastModified; plain Blob is named blob.
contract.distinctness: Entry-value type and metadata conversion, which URLSearchParams and remote-stream cases do not implement.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(form.get('unchanged') === file, true, 'File append without filename preserves File identity');
t.equal(renamed instanceof File && renamed !== file, true, 'explicit filename creates a renamed File');
t.equal(form.get('default').name, 'blob', 'plain Blob becomes File with default name');
contract.hypothesis: Appending a File may gratuitously clone it or rename it in place; Blob conversion may omit the default filename or lose type/lastModified.
contract.mechanism: FormData File identity and explicit filename conversion
preconditions: Reviewed exact direct-celld source/build/deployment pins and fresh isolated local store.
Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.

schedule.parallelism: two local body consumers joined with allSettled only in Y220; otherwise sequential

contract.source_observation: Pinned form-value conversion returns a File directly without a filename override and creates a new File for overrides or Blobs. The lastModified assertion is specifically the source-supported same-file metadata carry-through at harness.js 10899-10906; HTML create-an-entry independently supports identity/rename/bytes but does not spell out lastModified. This supporting assertion earns no separate case credit.
contract.title: Convert Blob and File form entries while preserving file metadata
trace: Append one File unchanged and once with a new filename.
Append an ordinary Blob without filename.
Assert File identity/renaming, bytes, fixed lastModified, type, original metadata, and default blob filename.
